invariants.description: second law: every reaction runs down its affinity, v A >= 0, so P_diss >= 0
invariants.expr: np.all(v_PGM*A_PGM >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PGM).max()*np.abs(A_PGM).max()) and np.all(v_GLGC*A_GLGC >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_GLGC).max()*np.abs(A_GLGC).max()) and np.all(v_GLGA*A_GLGA >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_GLGA).max()*np.abs(A_GLGA).max()) and np.all(v_PPA*A_PPA >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PPA).max()*np.abs(A_PPA).max()) and np.all(v_GLGP*A_GLGP >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_GLGP).max()*np.abs(A_GLGP).max()) and np.all(P_diss >= -1e-9*np.abs(P_diss).max())

invariants.description: glycogen is never negative (its activity vanishes as it runs out)
the ports report each chemostat's net production: j_G6P = -v_PGM, j_ATP = -v_GLGC, j_ADP = v_GLGA, j_Pi = 2 v_PPA - v_GLGP (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_G6P, -v_PGM, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ATP, -v_GLGC, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ADP, v_GLGA, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_Pi, 2.0*v_PPA - v_GLGP, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30)

bc_sweep.rationale: G6P from starving to a meal; ATP and ADP from a de-energised to a resting cell; Pi over an order of magnitude; pH 6.8 to 8
